author: Node.aec
name: Node.aec Revit Plugin (Licensing Lite)
description: Autodesk Revit add-in with Node.aec offline license verification built in (shared Node.aec tab, fail-closed gate, RevitYear matrix 2023-2027, release + installer scripts).

ProductSlug.description: Product slug in the Node.aec catalog (used by Gate.Validate; must match the entitlement claim).

AddInId.description: Unique GUID of this add-in for the .addin manifest. Generate a fresh one per plugin (never reuse).

AppId.description: Unique GUID of the installer (Windows Settings > Apps entry). One per product, shared by all Revit-year groups.
